chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ:

translations.en: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Yunus ibn Yaʿqub:

chunks.arabic_text: أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانَ بِهَمَذَانَ ذَكَرَ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ مَاتَ وَ كَانَ لَا يَعْرِفُ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ فَأَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةٍ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَ أَوْصَى أَنْ يُعْطَى شَيْءٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَسُئِلَ عَنْهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ كَيْفَ يُفْعَلُ بِهِ وَ أَخْبَرْنَاهُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يَعْرِفُ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ وَ أَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةٍ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ

translations.en: A man who was in Hamadhan mentioned that his father had died, and that he did not know this matter, so he made a bequest at the time of death and instructed that something be given in the way of Allah. Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام was asked about him, how it should be carried out, and we informed him that he did not know this matter and had made a bequest at the time of death.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ "لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَوْصَى إِلَيَّ أَنْ أَضَعَ مَالَهُ فِي يَهُودِيٍّ أَوْ نَصْرَانِيٍّ لَوَضَعْتُهُ فِيهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ

translations.en: So he said: "If a man were to entrust me by will to place his wealth with a Jew or a Christian, I would place it among them. Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says:

chunks.arabic_text: فَمَنْ بَدَّلَهُ بَعْدَ مَا سَمِعَهُ فَإِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

translations.en: “Then whoever changes it after having heard it, its sin is only upon those who change it. Indeed Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.”

chunks.arabic_text: فَانْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ يَخْرُجُ فِي هَذِهِ الْوُجُوهِ يَعْنِي الثُّغُورَ فَابْعَثُوا بِهِ إِلَيْهِ".

translations.en: Then look to one who goes out in these directions—meaning the frontier posts—and send it to him."
translations.ur: پھر ان لوگوں کی طرف دیکھو جو ان سمتوں میں نکلتے ہیں یعنی سرحدی چوکیوں کی طرف، اور اسے ان کے پاس بھیجو۔
translations.tr: Sonra bu yönlere çıkanlara—yani sınır karakollarına—bak ve onu onlara gönder.
translations.fa: سپس به کسی که به این جهات می‌رود—یعنی پاسگاه‌های مرزی—نگاه کن و آن را به او بفرست.
translations.id: Kemudian lihatlah kepada orang yang keluar ke arah-arah ini—maksudnya pos-pos perbatasan—dan kirimkanlah kepadanya.
translations.bn: তারপর তাদের দিকে তাকাও যারা এই দিকগুলোতে যায়—অর্থাৎ সীমান্ত পোস্টগুলোতে—এবং এটি তাদের কাছে পাঠাও।
translations.es: Luego mira a quien salga en estas direcciones—es decir, los puestos fronterizos—y envíalo a él.
translations.fr: Puis regarde celui qui sort dans ces directions—c’est-à-dire les postes frontières—et envoie-le-lui.
translations.de: Dann schau auf den, der in diese Richtungen hinausgeht—gemeint sind die Grenzposten—und schicke es zu ihm.
translations.ru: Затем посмотри на того, кто выходит в этих направлениях — то есть на пограничные посты — и отправь это ему.
translations.zh: 然后看向那些从这些方向出去的人——意指边境哨所——并把它送给他。

en.summary: This hadith establishes the obligation of carrying out a deceased person's valid bequest as instructed, even when the deceased did not recognize the truth of the matter. The Imam عليه السلام supports this with the Qur'anic warning against altering a will, then directs that the bequest for the way of Allah be given to someone serving at the frontier posts.
en.seo_question: Must a deceased person's bequest be fulfilled if he was not from the followers of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?

key_terms.هَذَا الْأَمْرَ: the matter of recognizing the truth and authority of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.وَصِيَّةٍ: a bequest or testament made before death
key_terms.فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: for the cause of Allah; a designated charitable or religious expenditure
key_terms.يَهُودِيٍّ أَوْ نَصْرَانِيٍّ: a Jew or a Christian, mentioned as recipients in the example of fulfilling a bequest
key_terms.الثُّغُورَ: the frontier outposts or border defense posts
